Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
What happens to the Enhanced Coagulant when used to strike and the opposing vampire dodges? Does it remain on the striking minion or is it lost/burned?

Enhanced Coagulant

Cardtype: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Weapon.
Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with “Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card.”.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
I believe enhanced coagulant just burns if its dodged. Dodge avoids all negative effects of a strike.

And putting it on enemy minion is a negative effect

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> What happens to the Enhanced Coagulant when used to strike and the opposing vampire dodges? Does it remain on the striking minion or is it lost/burned?
>
> Enhanced Coagulant
>
> Cardtype: Equipment
> Cost: 1 pool
> Weapon.
> Strike: 3 unpreventable damage and put this card on the opposing vampire; it becomes a card with “Cards requiring a Discipline cost this vampire +1 blood. After this vampire successfully hunts, burn this card.”.
>
The dodging minion takes no damage from the strike, and the equipment stays on the striking minion, ready to be used again as a future strike (just like a Rowan Ring for instance).
